Quests.Title: The Veil Remembers
Quests.Summary: An optional investigation of a repeating memory. Read the Dispatch and Archive traces, consult Odile, follow the service stair, align a living reference, silence a finite echo and bring its record home. No companion required.
Quests.Done: The record is safe in Dispatch. The echo was a fragment, not a new law for the Manor. Your modest payment is recorded once.
Quests.Floor: Existing venues and Underheart service passages

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: Malik, this receiver repeats a maintenance order from before the break. It is not Luma calling. Compare the Archive copy before anyone mistakes an echo for a person.

Steps.Objective: Enter Cinder Dispatch and examine receiver A.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to record the repeated tone
Steps.Objective: Record the clue from the working receiver.

Lines.Speaker: Third Eye
Lines.Text: TWO CARRIERS. ONE RECORD. NO LIVING VOICE CONFIRMED.

Steps.Objective: Enter the Resonance Archive and compare its old maintenance record.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to compare the steward record
Steps.Objective: The order names a shelter door, not a throne.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: A steward keeping a door open. Whatever he became, this is what someone needed him to do.

Steps.Objective: Carry the Archive trace to Odile at the existing Bondkeeper's Refuge. Dropped evidence can be recovered.

Lines.Speaker: Odile Marsh
Lines.Text: A creature answers what is here. A recording only repeats. If your companion is with you, settle it at the care station. Then compare its living response against that trace. You can use the manual controls if you travel alone.

Steps.Objective: Tend an earned companion at the care station, or use the station to continue alone. No bond is granted.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: Bring the trace down the service stair. The garden relay is quiet enough to separate the tones. Do not open a new tear for the sake of a recording.

Steps.Objective: Enter Pressure House and reach the real service stair.
Descend to Lantern Refuge through the stair; no teleport is required.
Reach the protected garden habitat. Its residents are witnesses, not targets.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to isolate the memory by hand
Steps.Objective: Isolate the recorded tone manually or use an earned companion exploration assist.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to compare the living response
Steps.Objective: Read the comparison after the relay settles.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: The living one changes its answer. The other voice never does. This is a memory caught in a damaged circuit.

Steps.Objective: Align three QUIET BEAT seals at the refuge relay. An earned companion may steady a seal.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: One shade and three mites are holding the service stores. That is the whole obstruction. Silence them and recover the trace; the habitat stays protected.

Steps.Objective: Reach the existing workshop service stores.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to ground the repeated signal
Steps.Objective: Commit only when ready: one shade and three mites; no reinforcements.
Silence the Repeating Witness and its three mites. Retreat or abandon to retry; no farmable kill loot.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to recover the memory trace
Steps.Objective: Take the record from the silenced circuit.
Carry the trace back up the Pressure House service stair to the Archive. Recover it after injury; no teleport.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to file the recovered trace
Steps.Objective: Preserve the fragment without treating it as a new command.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: It remembers a shelter. It cannot tell us what to do next. That part belongs to the living.

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: Filed as a damaged maintenance memory, with your account beside it. No voice was rescued; a dangerous mistake was stopped. Here is the agreed payment.

Steps.Objective: Leave Dispatch through its original entrance. The investigation ends in a calm world.
